default.notes: A visa is required in advance — through a Burkinabè embassy or the government's online visa service; check security advisories first, as most of the country is under do-not-travel warnings.

groups.notes: ECOWAS citizens enter freely under the Community's free-movement protocol — up to 90 days with a valid passport or ECOWAS travel document.

BF.notes: Home country — no entry requirements for Burkinabè citizens.
